title: BD-HazardVLM: Probing Vision-Language Models for Latent Defensive-Driving Hazards in Bangladesh Road Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2610.20627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used for driving-scene understanding, yet their defensive reasoning under weakly structured Global South traffic remains unclear. We introduce BD-HazardVLM, a diagnostic benchmark of 500 Bangladesh road-scene images, comprising 375 from RSUD20K and 125 from TFP-BD, annotated for hazard presence, primary hazard category, risk timing, severity, defensive actions, visible evidence, and hallucination- and Western-road-bias traps. We evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B, and MiniCPM-V-4.6 using a shared zero-shot task definition and structured output schema. Binary hazard-presence accuracy ranges from 88.0 percent to 89.2 percent, essentially matching the 89.0 percent majority-class baseline. Fine-grained reasoning is substantially weaker: category accuracy remains below 40 percent, risk-timing accuracy ranges from 1.6 percent to 12.4 percent, and exact defensive-action matching remains below 2 percen

translated_title: BD-HazardVLM：探究视觉语言模型在孟加拉国道路场景中对潜在防御性驾驶危险的识别能力
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型越来越多地被用于驾驶场景理解，但它们在弱结构化的全球南方交通环境下的防御性推理能力仍不清楚。我们提出了BD-HazardVLM，这是一个包含500张孟加拉国道路场景图像的诊断性基准，其中375张来自RSUD20K，125张来自TFP-BD，标注内容涵盖危险存在与否、主要危险类别、风险发生时机、严重程度、防御性动作、可见证据，以及幻觉陷阱和西方道路偏见陷阱。我们采用统一的零样本任务定义和结构化输出模式，评估了Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B和MiniCPM-V-4.6三个模型。结果显示，二元危险存在判断的准确率在88.0%至89.2%之间，基本与89.0%的多数类基线持平；而细粒度推理能力则明显较弱：类别判断准确率低于40%，风险时机判断准确率仅为1.6%至12.4%，防御性动作的精确匹配率低于2%。
tldr: 提出了BD-HazardVLM诊断基准，利用500张孟加拉国道路场景图像系统评估视觉语言模型对防御性驾驶危险的推理能力，发现模型虽能判断危险是否存在（接近多数类基线），但在危险类别、风险时机和防御动作等细粒度推理上表现严重不足。
en_tdlr: Introduces BD-HazardVLM, a diagnostic benchmark of 500 Bangladesh road-scene images probing vision-language models for defensive-driving hazard reasoning, showing that models barely exceed the majority-class baseline on hazard presence detection while failing substantially on fine-grained reasoning about hazard categories, risk timing, and defensive actions.
